text:
Radek Faksa has no goals in 18 games, and that's not a surprise to anyone who knows what he's for. He's back in Dallas after a season in St. Louis, playing 12 minutes a night as a fourth-line center and penalty killer.

Evolving-Hockey had him taking chances away at the 92nd percentile among forwards last season and creating very little at the other end, bottom 4%. Same story this season: the Stars are about even in expected goals with him on at five on five, and his line isn't meant to score.

The goal will come at some point (1.7 expected and nothing yet), but nobody in Dallas is counting.

His best moment of the week was described by Jesse Granger of The Athletic in Vegas: Faksa headed a puck out of the air with the top of his helmet, loud enough to hear in the press box. That's a fourth-liner's season in one play. Dallas has won eight of his last ten games.

What to watch: penalty kill results and faceoff work, not the scoresheet.
